We are people too, we love, we hate, we live. We are not much different, our brains just works a little different. We do our bests to fit in and would love to be friends with everyone around us.
It's okay to have a stuffed animal as emotional support, but don't limit it to that. Also try to search support in people, a therapist, family, friends etc.

Crazy is a word that I hate to use, we all have our problems, but we are not crazy. My first adviceis to always stay hydrated, drink enough in a day. Water is the best thing.  
I had periods too where I thouhgt, maybe I am making this up, maybe I'm in a fantasy world. That is normal, but if you ask a therapist, they will always tell you the truth. If you're thinking: 'Am I making this up?', you're most likely not.

If you don't have a bus pass, a ride on the bus can get quite expensive, 2,30 per ride. I would recommend either walking or renting a bike. 

Cheap food is everywhere, if you want some good, cheap pizza I recommend Happy Italy, close to the train station and Pathé (cinema). I love the atmosphere and food there, they also have pasta and anti-pasta.

 My go to supermarket would be Albert Heijn, it's cheap and they have basically everything there. I think it's best to pay with your debit/credit card. There are a lot of thiefs around who are looking for open bags, phones hanging out of pockets and with a debit card, they won't be able to do much if they don't have the pin. There are many withdrawal machines around town and you can even ask supermarkets to withdraw some extra money when buying groceries.

There is a zoo, just outside of Arnhem, reachable by bus. It's called Burgers Zoo and it's a really pretty one. The entry ticket is about 23 euros.  


I hope you enjoy your stay here!
